answer_2.quote: We follow previous clustering works and adopt Accuracy (ACC) and Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) to evaluate different approaches. ... we use tf-idf and word diversity (word-div.) to evaluate the top topical phrases.

answer_4.quote: Annotators are asked to select the intruder phrase ... we asked 4 annotators to answer these questions ... 3 annotators evaluate four models on Gest and KP20k datasets.
answer_4.guideline: For phrase intrusion: select the intruder phrase from a set of 6 phrases (5 from one topic, 1 from another). For coherence: evaluate if the top 50 phrases in a topic are coherent (most phrases represent the same topic).
